## Acceptance
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!
- A2: lib/bye.txt contains the line Bye, Almir!

## Verify
- A1: test
- A2: test

## Request
Make the greeting in lib/greet.txt say Hello, Almir! instead of Hello!
